summary: Fail fast when the local collector reports expired authentication and block downstream publication escalation until the same-date community gate is healthy.
issues: Collector emitted COMMUNITY_LOGIN_REQUIRED with exit zero, so the wrapper continued to the failed gate and retried unattended
Supervision reported missing publication while the upstream local gate was blocked
risks: Human QR/login renewal and one owning local collector rerun remain required for 2026-08-30 data publication
lessons: Collector semantic failure markers must outrank process exit codes
Downstream publication cannot be missing until upstream data is publishable
reusable_rules: Stop Community Intelligence retries immediately on COMMUNITY_LOGIN_REQUIRED
Only escalate missing publication after healthy same-date data and gate
